Read one work item without expanding the full ledger or event history

Usage: awr work [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  activate            Preview activation of a draft, then accept the reviewed source and revision
  edit                Preview a small edit by work ID; apply the reviewed change without editing YAML
  graph               Inspect dependencies, impact, readiness and claims without admitting execution
  assess              Explain management requirements without changing execution or completion policy
  manage              Record attributed observations and retain continuous management after upgrade
  admit               Record a work admission proposal or decision for governed work
  contain             Record a containment proposal or decision for the children of a parent work
  reassess            Record a reassessment decision for a work whose records show repeated failures or an unknown outcome
  gap                 Open, resolve or withdraw a gap in the intent, acceptance, design, plan or definition of a work
  finding             Record a review finding of a work, or close one; blocking findings return the work, the rest are deferred
  prepare             Prepare readiness and the required context together; does not acknowledge consumption
  prepare-completion  Validate a real report and derive evidence metadata without registering or completing
  create              Preview or accept a source-backed draft, optionally attempting activation
  create-status       Read the durable outcome for a stable creation request without applying it
  create-recover      Explicitly recover a pending creation while retaining externally changed bytes
  progress            Record progress in the source ledger; requires an active owned runtime claim
  block               Mark in-progress source work blocked with a concrete blocker
  unblock             Clear a blocked source state after rechecking required dependencies
  cancel              Cancel nonterminal source work and release this session's runtime claims
  reopen              Reopen completed/cancelled source work to planned with a reason and next action
  complete            Complete source work only after verifying dependencies, acceptance and actual evidence reports
  claim               Acquire a runtime claim for the selected session; never rewrites source ownership
  release             Release an explicit claim held by the selected session
  history             Read bounded event summaries for one work item, including retained history
  handoff             Close a session and hand off its latest checkpoint, optionally transferring its claim
  show                Show source state, readiness, acceptance and related decision/evidence summaries
  help                Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --project <PROJECT>  [default: .]
      --json               
  -h, --help               Print help
